name: GenAI-Bench-1600
description:
This page contains only the zip format data of GenAI-Bench-1600, which can be downloaded manually or using git clone.
We recommend using the parquet format. The code is as follows:

from datasets import load_dataset

dataset = load_dataset("BaiqiL/GenAI-Bench")
evaluation_method: accuracy (task-specific) and human_eval for generative tasks
reputation: A niche benchmark with limited but growing use in community evaluations of generative models.
